question: How much context can an AI coding agent safely not see?
hypothesis: Policy-driven reduction can remove substantial operational payload without reducing correctness when provenance and raw-evidence escalation remain available.
correctness_gate: Each arm must produce the fixture-defined correct repository result and pass the same deterministic oracle before efficiency comparison.
primary_metric: Correctness pass rate by final model-visible context fraction.
secondary_metrics: provider-recorded input tokens when later available
provider-recorded latency and cost when later available
unfrozen_launch_inputs: allocation seed commitment and sealed mapping
claim_limits: Offline qualification is not an EXP-001 subject run or result.
The corpus is Python-only and supports no cross-language claim.
Byte measurements do not establish token, cost, latency, correctness, or causal savings.
No safe context-reduction frontier is established before controlled subject runs and replication.
